stories.headline: Google Vids now lets you star in your own AI videos
stories.dek: Google is adding personalized AI avatars to Vids that let users create videos starring a digital version of themselves, alongside Gemini Omni-powered tools for generating and editing videos from prompts and reference images.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by AS Photography on Pexels

stories.headline: Fortnite is getting a bunch of AI-powered ‘personas’
stories.dek: Get ready for more AI characters in Fortnite. Developer Epic Games is going to let Fortnite creators publish experiences featuring characters with AI-powered voices starting on July 30th, and ahead of that launch, it's created 36 characters with "consistent voices and personas" that creators can use
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Vlad Gorshkov on Unsplash

stories.headline: Salad Chains Are Seeing Foot Traffic Drop Over Cyclosporiasis Fears
stories.dek: Foot traffic to leafy green chains is falling, data shows. Still, a few brave souls who spoke to WIRED were determined to get their fix. “I honestly didn’t even think about” the risk of explosive diarrhea, one says.

stories.headline: OnePlus, the ‘Flagship-Killer’ Smartphone Brand, Is All but Dead
stories.dek: The original OnePlus phone disrupted the mobile market 13 years ago with its affordable price and top-end specs. Now, the company is exiting North America and Europe to focus on China.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Vimal Krishnattri on Unsplash

stories.headline: Uber’s $14.8B Delivery Hero deal would nearly double its global footprint
stories.dek: Uber has agreed to acquire Delivery Hero in a $14.8 billion all-stock deal that would nearly double the company’s global footprint and create one of the world’s largest food-delivery platforms outside China.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Robert Anasch on Unsplash

stories.headline: Yes, you can now order DoorDash from the command line
stories.dek: DoorDash is opening a limited beta of dd-cli, a command-line tool that lets developers and AI agents search stores, build carts, and place orders from the terminal, marking another step toward software designed for AI agents instead of just humans.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Brett Jordan on Unsplash
